method.eyeIdentity: Positive native skeleton X. source-screen-left is smaller X; avatarFacing=-1 swaps rendered screen sides.
method.whiteTexels: Actual atlas pixels inside native UV triangles, alpha >=32; verified separate reflection/tear cutouts use RGB minimum >=180, spread <=80. Painted iris/face dots use minimum >=200, spread <=45 to separate golden iris gradients from white dots. Compact 8-connected regions are checked against the iris footprint; reviewed white eye fills/lid strokes and stars remain distinct from reflections.
method.coloredIris: Opaque saturated atlas texels inside the native iris footprint, tested through actual mesh triangles, slot alpha, later-layer alpha and Spine clipping.
method.occlusion: Forward-project alpha-selected atlas pixel probes with native barycentric UV weights, then sample later atlas layers at their authored world triangles and blend modes. Straight-alpha normal/additive/multiply/screen destination coefficients match the supplied runtime. Native triangle/UV area ratios account for a flattened closed-eye mesh having zero visible area. Empty draw-order slots correctly end clipping.
method.interpolation: Original Spine 4.1.56 runtime decodes supplied 4.1.23 skeletons; no hand-written interpolation or deformation.
method.openEyeSampling: 120 Hz plus all exact authored eye key times over one period, body and mouth fixed at their authored initial pose.
method.blinkSampling: 120 Hz plus all authored keys over the original one-shot blink, no camera or stage movement.
method.lowerTracks: Native mouth-open variants are separate compositions; eye-overlapping body/mouth timelines are checked at their exact authored keys.
method.visibilityLimit: Visibility fractions use up to 64 stratified probes per white component and 32 per colored component; texture component counts are exhaustive. Source raster snapshots corroborate visible appearance.
